title: Stable SMP
description: This is the STABLE SMP! A deathban Hardcore Server. But you get a second Chance.
body:
## **This is the STABLE SMP!!!**


A Hardcore Server where dying means getting banned for a week. 
If you die you instantly leave the game and can only join back after 7 days. To make this work, the mod [Panda Death Ban](https://modrinth.com/mod/panda-death-ban) is installed on the Server, alongside [StasisRods](https://modrinth.com/mod/stasisrods), [Totem in a Barrel](https://modrinth.com/mod/totem-in-barrel) and [Farlands Reborn](https://modrinth.com/mod/farlands-reborn), to allow Stasis Chambers and Farlands like on Unstable. The Farlands spawn in at 12,550,821 blocks along the X or Z axis

Also, every side and corner of the Farlands have actual Orbital Strike Canons with Multiple Chests full of Nuke and Stab Shots that are getting refilled from time to time.
